verification_notes: Verified against screenshot. Printed text transcription accurate (THE MAIN BOOK / The Lion's Share Treasure / THERE'S TREASURE INSIDE / A Treasure Hunt by / JON COLLINS-BLACK / 'A literary project unlike anything else. A true and monumental treasure quest.' / NATIONAL BESTSELLER). 'The Lion's Share' and 'Treasure' appear on separate lines in image. Top-center coin is a physical silver Bitcoin coin reading '999 FINE SILVER' and '2013' (previously just 'Bitcoin coin'). Bottom-right image is a SINGLE ornate engraved gold box (previously mis-described as 'multiple treasure boxes... represents 5 boxes' -- corrected to one box). Red diamond (top-right) shows a portrait on red with faint italic text; partially legible fragments include 'for the round, yellow eyes of the ham[let]', 'Growing filmy with mists.', and "And Amelia's poem 'Courage' giv[es us more]..." -- this is text related to Amelia Earhart's poem 'Courage' (cf. Ch. 7). Most of the red-document italic text is too faint to transcribe verbatim (see uncertainties).
